topic: Where in the world are tropical rainforests?
rationaleNote: A single photograph-led Amazon overview earns wall space because it gives children a durable, self-contained reminder of the place's visible features and its cross-border extent. The map-led location sequence and full three-part model remain on the lesson materials because their final visual supports are not available as reusable wall assets.

groups.title: Where it is
items: The Amazon rainforest crosses national borders.

groups.title: What it is like
items: The Amazon has dense forest, huge rivers and places where people live.
